title: The Truck with the Turning Drum
synopsis: A concrete mixer truck brings material for the bridge supports while Gus wonders whether it is a washing machine for caps.
continuity_state: Before: The bridge site has excavated support areas but no completed foundation. After: Concrete is placed in prepared forms for bridge supports on the two banks. The crew protects it and allows time to gain strength. Molly remains across the brook.
